data.name: Jayasurya
data.gender_notes: Jayasurya is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jayasurya is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Jaya’ meaning victory and ‘Surya’ meaning god. This name signifies the victory of God over all obstacles. The name Jayasurya carries the meaning “Victory of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jayasurya usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May the divine god grant you victory in all aspects of your life.
data.etymology: Jayasurya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayasurya total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_sanskrit.name: जयशुर्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जय (Jaya) - Victory, शुर्य (Shurya) - Ruler, य (Ya) - Wealth. So, Jayasurya means 'Victorious Ruler of Wealth'.

in_hindi.name: जयशुर्य
in_hindi.meaning: जय (Jaya) - विजयी (Vijayi) - Victorious, शुर्य (Shurya) - प्राजन्न (Prajann) - Ruler, य (Ya) - धन (Dhan) - Wealth. So, Jayasurya means 'Victorious Ruler of Wealth' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: ஜயசுரிய
in_tamil.meaning: ஜய (Jaya) - விஜயம் (Vijayam) - Victory, சுரிய (Suriyam) - அமர் (Amar) - Ruler, ய (Ya) - தேவல் (Theval) - Wealth. So, Jayasurya means 'Victorious Ruler of Wealth' in Tamil as well.

in_telugu.name: జెయశూయ
in_telugu.meaning: జెయ (Jeypa) - విజయోదేశ (Vijayodhisha) - Victorious, శూయ (Shooya) - ప్రజేశ (Prakesha) - Ruler, య (Ya) - పొదుపు (Podupu) - Wealth. So, Jayasurya means 'Victorious Ruler of Wealth' in Telugu as well.

It is a prestigious name bestowed upon individuals who are believed to possess strong leadership qualities, courage, and the ability to overcome adversity. The name is reminiscent of ancient Hindu kings and warriors, who were revered for their victories in battles and their devotion to their gods and goddesses.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Jayasurya represents the victory of the divine power of the universe over all worldly challenges. It is a constant reminder that no matter how difficult the situation may seem, the divine force of the universe is always greater and can be relied upon for protection and guidance. This name is a source of inspiration for those who seek to overcome their inner obstacles and achieve spiritual growth and enlightenment. Additionally, the name is a reminder of the importance of devotion to the divine, and the belief that ultimately, victory belongs to the gods.
